# hetznerrobot_currency (Data Source)

Reads the currency of the account — the one every price of the product data sources is in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_currency" "account" {}

output "currency" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_currency.account.currency
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency code, e.g. `EUR`.
